newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD jumps on undersea cable capacity sale news.
newsitem.headline: KDD jumps on undersea cable capacity sale news.

text.p: Shares in Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) jumped on Friday morning, propelled by news that it would sell some data transmission capacity in undersea fiber-optic cables to DDI Corp, brokers said.
As of 0133 GMT, the shares were up 260 yen at 7,950 yen.

Domestic long-distance telecommunications operator DDI said on Friday that it would buy 20 percent of the data transmission capacity in undersea fiber-optic cables that international telecoms operator KDD plans to lay around Japan.
A DDI spokesman told Reuters that it and KDD had basically agreed on the purchase, although details, including the cost, had yet to be discussed.
